gap_evidence.central_gap: Visual tokenization is fragmented across task and modality: reconstruction tokenizers preserve pixels but lack semantics, understanding encoders capture semantics but cannot reconstruct, and most methods are image-only or video-only rather than image/video/3D unified.
subgaps: Multimodal LLMs lack a BPE-like shared visual token space that supports generation and understanding.
Convolutional tokenizers scale poorly, while pure transformer visual tokenizers often rely on unstable adversarial training.
Existing unified reconstruction+understanding tokenizers such as VILA-U and UniTok are limited to images.
A unified tokenizer must handle arbitrary image resolutions, temporal duration, and 3D sparse structure without separate encoders.
gap_evidence.why_now: SigLIP2/Naflex visual encoders, sparse transformers, FSQ quantization, and large multimodal training data make unified image-video-3D tokenization practical.

method_evidence.core_method: AToken is a pure-transformer visual tokenizer that maps images, videos, and 3D assets into a shared sparse 4D latent space, with one encoder supporting semantic understanding and reconstruction through continuous or discrete tokens.
important_equations: Sparse latent set: z={(z_i,p_i)} where p_i=[t,x,y,z] in 4D space.
Image reconstruction: L_rec=lambda_1 L1 + lambda_LPIPS L_LPIPS + lambda_GRAM L_GRAM + lambda_CLIP L_CLIP.
Overall objective: L=lambda_rec L_rec + lambda_sem L_sem + lambda_KL L_KL.

limitations: Training from scratch is far beyond normal 7B-lab scale: up to 256 H100 GPUs and large internal datasets.

papers.gap_evidence: Sampling-based LLM decoding often needs task- and temperature-specific hyperparameter tuning. Fixed-threshold or single-token-relative truncation methods can degrade at high temperature, admit too many low-quality tail tokens, or require edge-case fallbacks when the candidate set becomes empty.
papers.method_evidence: p-less computes a threshold from the entire temperature-adjusted token distribution: L[P] = sum_i p_i^2, interpretable as the probability of a correct random guess, the exponential of negative Renyi-2 collision entropy, and a second-moment statistic. Tokens with probability at least L[P] are retained and renormalized before sampling. p-lessnorm relaxes the threshold to (|V| * sum_i p_i^2 - 1) / (|V| - 1), favoring diversity when coherence pressure can be lower.
papers.result_and_limitation_evidence: p-less and p-lessnorm have top or near-top AUC across most reasoning datasets and models. Table 1 reports, for example, Mistral-7B AUCs of p-less/p-lessnorm: CSQA 0.697/0.692, GPQA 0.239/0.222, GSM8K 0.562/0.564, QASC 0.736/0.739; Llama2-7B p-less/p-lessnorm: CSQA 0.503/0.503, GPQA 0.242/0.248, GSM8K 0.267/0.267, QASC 0.537/0.538. events.claim: SPARK decomposes reconstruction into VLM symbolic/visual guidance, graph-conditioned part generation, and joint refinement.
The part DiT is trained by rectified-flow velocity matching on per-part mesh latents from PartNet-Mobility-derived objects.
